Context: 4. Weightage for promotion, etc.

## 4. Weightage for promotion, etc.  
- (a) Eligible officers shall be given due recognition in the matter of
- (i) promotion in cadre posts;
- (ii) deputation to Central tenure posts; and
- (iii)
- courses of training abroad.
- The general requirement of at least three years service in a cadre post between two Central tenure deputations may be relaxed to two years
- (b) in deserving cases of meritorious service in the North-East.
